title: 第1章 楚梁
content_zh:
第1章楚梁
“你好，我叫楚梁。”
一名锦衣束袖的少年端坐在椅上，他的身量偏瘦，两鬓垂肩，面皮白净，眉眼清朗，有些娃娃脸，脸上带着招人喜欢的微笑，正在做自我介绍，声音温和。
“楚公子好，奴家名唤一捻红。”
对面，则是一名娇柔的女子，金簪云鬓，面若桃花，正用一抹衣袖挡脸轻笑，露出盈盈的一对眉眼。
中间是一桌丰盛的菜肴，色香俱全。所在之地，则是一处陈设典雅、烛光明亮的阁楼，屏风画山水，红罗帐轻垂。
“姑娘的名字听起来……很雅致。”楚梁笑道。
“公子是第一次来这种地方吧？”一捻红看他样子，柔声问道。
“确实。”楚梁颔首，“之前长辈一直不让来，说我还小……”
“公子多大年纪啊？”一捻红随即问道。
“十七岁。”楚梁答。
“那也不小了，早该自己来试试了嘛。”一捻红轻笑，“试过，就不是小孩子啦。”
“我……其实之前也经常试，只不过都是在家附近，也都是一些比较小的……”楚梁不好意思地笑了笑，“像你这么大的，确实是第一次遇见。”
“呵呵。”女子目光缠绵，“年少不知姐姐好啊……”
楚梁认真道：“那一会儿我如果有什么经验不足的地方，姑娘还请多担待，也希望你……多多配合，先提前谢谢了。”
“放心啦，这么客气干什么。”一捻红轻抬素手，斟了一杯酒，推到楚梁面前，“姐姐一会儿保证给你升天的体验。”
“额……”楚梁眨眨眼：“这个话应该我来说吧，我保证让姑娘升天。”
“哼哼。”一捻红媚眼一转，“小家伙口气还挺大，对自己的功夫这么自信吗？”
“我的功夫……可能是修炼得还不到家，不过我可以尽量用道具弥补。”楚梁道。
“哟呵？还用道具？”一捻红眉毛挑了挑，“看不出你一本正经的样子，挺会玩的啊，带什么了？掏出来我看看。”

“也好，那我们便早些开始。”楚梁点点头，接着手在腰间一翻，掏出一物，哐当撂在桌上。
居然是半块金灿灿的砖头，看上去光华流转，不似凡物。
女子的面色变了变，“我还真不知道这玩意怎么用……你要玩变态的我可不陪你啊。”
“嗯……”楚梁沉吟了下，突然一指女子背后，“那是什么？”
“什么？”一捻红回头去看。
对面的温润少年突然暴起，一把抄起桌上的板砖，一砖拍在了女子的后脑！
一砖落下，有一道金光涟漪扩散开来，紧接着就见女子脑后被砸的地方，居然窜出黑气！
“啊——”一捻红痛苦地抱住后脑，高声怪叫，“你……你骗我！”
她一边叫一边起身后退两步，接着黑气从后脑如喷泉般蔓延出来，妖气森森！整个人光华一转，突然化作一只一丈长短的巨型蜘蛛！蜘蛛的腹部有一张人脸，正是方才一捻红的面孔。只是再没了面若桃花的美艳，有的只是狰狞与愤怒。
这看上去人畜无害的小年轻，居然下手这么黑，蜘蛛精的愤怒是肉眼可见得强烈。
一砖之下，原形毕露！
此时楚梁已然收起金砖，平静地面对着眼前可怖的妖物，微笑道：“我可没骗你，我确实是第一次自己来除妖。”
“嗐——”巨型蜘蛛怪吼连连，“哪里来的毛头小子，看我不把你碎尸万段！”
“我乃蜀山派弟子，有人向蜀山通报此间有妖物作祟，假设娼馆，暗害人命。我自山门领命，特来斩妖除魔！”楚梁声音铿锵道。
“蜀山弟子？”蜘蛛精闻言，当即心生惧意。蜀山派身为当世仙门九天之一，就算近年来有些许没落，积威仍旧能令寻常妖魔胆寒！
但见它张口吐出一团红芒，当空化作一张大网，朝楚梁罩过来。而本躯则转过头，八只蛛腿齐齐发力，蹭的一下便窜到门口，想要逃窜。
可惜，它的阻敌之计并没有用。楚梁身形一掠，便躲过了蛛网，同时左手竖起剑指，一声清喝：“御剑术！出！”
只见他左手腕上光华一闪，腕上戴着的手环陡然化作流光飞出，呛啷啷间成为一道飞剑！
只一剑，那蜘蛛精的偌大身躯避无可避，当场被剑光洞穿。
“啊！”那巨型蜘蛛惨叫一声，跌落下来，轰嘭两声，落到一楼，砸塌了地面，露出了木板之下的一片森森白骨。

可见先前此间害死了多少人命。
隐约间有一道常人无法看到的金光，从蜘蛛精尸体上飘出，汇入楚梁的体内。
他心满意足地收剑，那飞剑重新化作手环套在腕上。
尘埃落定。
这才长呼出一口气。
楚梁确实是第一次……领独自下山除妖的任务，先前面上平静，心里其实是有一些紧张的。
这蜘蛛精虽然修为不高，但是擅长障眼法，幻化人形难以辨别。如果不是有准确的情报，加上手上的独门法宝，楚梁可能也没这么好对付它。
结束战斗，楚梁却没有急着离开，而是又在原地盘坐下来，闭目冥神。
神识一沉，就来到了一片黑暗空间之中。这里空荡荡的，只有一座高高的白塔矗立在前。
九层六角，巍峨耸立，塔身遍布着繁复晦涩的铭文与图画，古奥庄严。
楚梁走进白塔内，就见白塔里面满是竖立黑色栏杆的铁牢，竟似是监狱！一间一间数之不尽，但都是空的，只有一间牢笼之中有东西。
那间铁牢里是一团金色虚影，看样子，似乎正是一只大蜘蛛……
铁牢没有门，只有一堵墙，墙上印着一个红色的“炼”字。楚梁上前，轻轻按动。
红芒一闪，那金色虚影瞬间消失。
而一团白色光华则从铁牢中飘了出来。
没错，楚梁每斩杀一只妖物，这座塔中便会出现一个虚影。炼化了这个虚影，就能得到宝物……就好像是对斩妖除魔的奖励。
楚梁伸手接住那团白光，发现光芒敛去，留在手中的是一捆红绳，心中也得到了一道感应。
【缚妖绳】：
对敌时以真气催动，缚妖绳将自动对敌人施行严密的龟甲缚。在使敌人丧失战斗力的同时，也可以摧毁其心理防线，甚至开发其隐藏人格，威力巨大。
哈哈哈哈终于又开新书啦，第一天发三章，之后每天更两章，现在起点前期追读特别重要，感兴趣的朋友们尽量不要养哦，没事来

（假期在四十多天的封城里结束了，太悲催了。现在每天除了考虑写什么，还要考虑吃什么……而且现在政策是一栋楼有阳性，很可能全楼拉走隔离，每天日子都提心吊胆的，可太难了。但就是这么艰苦，依然会努力为大家散播欢笑散播爱的。）

Chapter 1 Chu Liang
"Hello, my name is Chu Liang."
A young man in brocade clothes and sleeves was sitting on the chair. He was thin, with hanging temples, fair skin, clear eyebrows, and a baby face. He had an endearing smile on his face. He was introducing himself with a gentle voice.
"Hello, Mr. Chu. My name is Yi Nian Hong."
Opposite, there is a delicate woman with golden hairpins on her temples and a peach-shaped face. She is covering her face with a sleeve and smiling softly, revealing a pair of plump eyebrows.
In the middle is a table of sumptuous dishes, all delicious and delicious. The location is an attic with elegant furnishings and bright candlelight. The screen is painted with landscapes and the red tent hangs lightly.
"The girl's name sounds...very elegant." Chu Liang smiled.
"Is this your first time coming to a place like this, young master?" Yi Nianhong looked at his appearance and asked softly.
"Indeed." Chu Liang nodded, "The elders have not allowed me to come before, saying that I am still young..."
"How old is the young master?" Yi Nianhong asked immediately.
"Seventeen years old." Chu Liang replied.
"You're not too young then. You should have tried it yourself a long time ago." Yi Nianhong chuckled, "If you try it, you won't be a child anymore."
"I...actually I have tried many times before, but they were always near home, and they were always smaller..." Chu Liang smiled sheepishly, "This is indeed the first time I have met someone as old as you."
"Haha." The woman's eyes were lingering, "I'm young and don't know how good my sister is..."
Chu Liang said seriously: "If I have any inexperience at that moment, please bear with me, girl. I also hope that you... will cooperate a lot. Thank you in advance."
"Don't worry, why are you so polite?" Yi Nianhong raised her hand lightly, poured a glass of wine, and pushed it in front of Chu Liang, "Sister, I promise to give you the experience of ascending to heaven in a while."
"Uh..." Chu Liang blinked: "I should say this. I promise to let the girl ascend to heaven."
"Humph." Yi Twisted her red eyes and rolled her eyes, "The little guy is quite loud. Are you so confident in your own kung fu?"
"My kung fu... may not be perfect yet, but I can try my best to make up for it with props." Chu Liang said.
"Haha? Are you still using props?" He raised his red eyebrows, "I can't tell you are serious, but you are quite good at playing. What did you bring? Take it out and let me take a look."
"Okay, let's start early." Chu Liang nodded, then turned his hand around his waist, took out something, and dropped it on the table.
It was actually half a golden brick, and it looked radiant and unlike anything ordinary.
The woman's expression changed, "I really don't know how to use this thing... If you want to play something perverted, I won't accompany you."
"Hmm..." Chu Liang pondered for a moment, then suddenly pointed at the woman's back, "What is that?"
"What?" Yi Nianhong looked back.
The gentle young man opposite suddenly got angry, picked up the bricks on the table, and hit the woman on the back of the head with one brick!
When a brick fell, a ripple of golden light spread out, and then black energy came out of the place where the woman's head was hit!
"Ah——" Yi Nian Hong hugged the back of his head in pain and screamed loudly, "You...you lied to me!"
She stood up and took two steps back while shouting, and then black energy spread from the back of her head like a fountain, and it was full of evil energy! His whole body suddenly turned into a giant spider about one foot long! There is a human face on the spider's abdomen, it is the face that turned red just now. It's just that she no longer has the beauty of a peach blossom face, but only ferociousness and anger.
This seemingly harmless young man actually acted in such a dark way. The spider spirit's anger was so intense that it was visible to the naked eye.
Under one brick, the true colors are revealed!
At this time, Chu Liang had already put away the gold bricks, calmly faced the terrifying monster in front of him, and said with a smile: "I'm not lying to you, this is indeed my first time to get rid of the monster myself."
"Ouch -" the giant spider roared repeatedly, "Where did you come from, you idiot? I won't cut you into pieces!"
"I am ShushanHe sent a disciple, and someone reported to Shushan that there was a monster causing trouble here, pretending to be a prostitute, and murdering people. I took orders from the mountain gate and came here to slay demons! " Chu Liang said with a sonorous voice.
"Disciple of Shushan? "When the Spider Spirit heard this, he immediately felt fear in his heart. As one of the nine immortal sects in the world, Shushan Sect, even if it has declined slightly in recent years, its accumulated power can still make ordinary demons tremble!
But I saw it spit out a ball of red light from its mouth, turned into a big net in the air, and covered Chu Liang. The main body turned its head, all eight spider legs exerted their strength, and rushed to the door, trying to escape.
Unfortunately, its tactic of blocking the enemy was of no use. Chu Liang dodged the cobweb with a flash of his body. At the same time, he raised his sword finger with his left hand and shouted: "Sword control! out! "
I saw a flash of light on his left wrist, and the bracelet on his wrist suddenly turned into a stream of light and flew out, turning into a flying sword!
With just one strike of the sword, the huge body of the spider spirit was unable to escape, and was pierced by the sword light on the spot.
"Ah! "The giant spider screamed and fell down. With two bangs, it landed on the first floor and collapsed on the ground, revealing a dense mass of white bones under the wooden board.
It can be seen how many lives were lost here before.
There was a faint golden light that ordinary people couldn't see, floating out from the spider spirit's body and entering Chu Liang's body.
He sheathed his sword with satisfaction, and the flying sword turned into a bracelet again and was put on his wrist.
The dust has settled.
Then he took a long breath.
It was indeed the first time for Chu Liang... to lead the task of going down the mountain alone to eliminate demons. He was calm on the outside, but he was actually a little nervous in his heart.
Although this spider spirit is not highly cultivated, it is good at blinding people and can be difficult to distinguish by transforming into a human form. If it weren't for the accurate information and the unique magic weapon in his hand, Chu Liang might not be so easy to deal with it.
After the battle ended, Chu Liang did not leave in a hurry. Instead, he sat down on the same spot and closed his eyes.
As soon as his consciousness sank, he came into a dark space. It's empty here, with only a tall white tower standing in front of it.
It has nine floors and six corners, and stands tall and majestic. The tower is covered with complex and obscure inscriptions and pictures, which is ancient and solemn.
Chu Liang walked into the White Tower and saw that the White Tower was full of iron cells with black railings. It looked like a prison! There are countless cells, but they are all empty. Only one cage has something in it.
There was a golden shadow in that iron prison, which seemed to be a big spider...
The iron prison has no door, only a wall with the word "Lian" printed in red on the wall. Chu Liang stepped forward and pressed gently.
There was a flash of red light, and the golden shadow disappeared instantly.
And a ball of white light floated out from the iron prison.
That's right, every time Chu Liang kills a monster, a shadow will appear in the tower. After refining this phantom, you can get treasure... It's like a reward for slaying demons.
Chu Liang stretched out his hand to catch the white light, and found that the light faded away, leaving a bundle of red rope in his hand, and he also got a feeling in his heart.
[Demon binding rope]:
When facing an enemy, activate it with your true energy, and the demon-binding rope will automatically bind the enemy tightly. While depriving the enemy of combat effectiveness, it can also destroy its psychological defenses and even develop its hidden personality, which is extremely powerful.
